blockers.name: Evidence admission
blockers.affected_scope: All 60 sections; 28 WEAK, 32 UNOBSERVED; all claim/citation packets
blockers.root_cause: Citation mechanics exist, but no claim-level validated primary evidence was admitted.
blockers.smallest_general_remediation: Versioned admission contract, repository candidate validation, claim-to-source coverage ledger, and fail-closed audit.
acceptance_tests: every admitted claim has primary-source provenance

blockers.name: Human decisions
blockers.affected_scope: BR-001..BR-007; RESP-001..RESP-002; CHDEC-001..CHDEC-006 and their frozen affected IDs
blockers.root_cause: Seven boundaries plus responsibility and hierarchy choices have no authoritative owner decision.
blockers.smallest_general_remediation: Versioned decision packet preserving alternatives and recording explicit owner selections without inference.

blockers.name: Cost methodology
blockers.affected_scope: CH-B-S08, CH-D-S01..S02, CH-E-S03/S08..S16, CH-F-S01, CH-G-S01..S02 and derived assets
blockers.root_cause: Dataset provenance, base year, currency/unit conversion, inflation treatment, and reproducible derived metrics are unspecified or unevidenced.
blockers.smallest_general_remediation: Versioned cost-method contract plus explicit analytical choices and reproducibility fixtures.

blockers.name: Freshness/current-information control
blockers.affected_scope: Historical/current/statistical claims, initially CH-A-S03..S05/S07..S08/S10..S11, then every time-sensitive admitted claim
blockers.root_cause: No as-of date, source-age class, refresh rule, or freshness audit has been applied after evidence admission.
blockers.smallest_general_remediation: Versioned freshness policy and claim ledger with as-of dates, expiry rules, and stale-claim rejection.

blockers.name: Visual rights / evidence validation
blockers.affected_scope: 60/60 section asset plans; 0 candidate assets; all future source visuals and derived assets
blockers.root_cause: Plans exist, but evidence availability, provenance, licence/permission, and derivation reproducibility were never validated.
blockers.smallest_general_remediation: Versioned asset ledger enforcing provenance, rights, evidence linkage, and reproducible derivation before release.
blockers.proposed_phase: PRE-WRITING VISUAL EVIDENCE AND RIGHTS VALIDATION V1
acceptance_tests: every retained source asset has rights/provenance

execution_order: PRE-WRITING VISUAL EVIDENCE AND RIGHTS VALIDATION V1
dependencies: Human decisions precede final scope-bound evidence mapping.
Repository admission precedes identification of residual external gaps.
Cost, freshness, and visual controls precede admission of their external evidence.
All remediations precede readiness re-audit and any drafting decision.
